claims.evidence: Photos show stacked used tyres, but no readable brand/country-of-origin or distributor markings.
Photos show tread patterns and general wear, but no tread-depth measurement (mm) or clear scale to confirm 90%.
Photos do not show close-ups of tread/sidewalls where patches/repairs would be visible.
Photos show general sidewall wear, but bulges would require close inspection of each tyre; not clearly shown.
Photos do not show DOT date, vehicle year, or any documentation linking tyres to a 2023 car.

risks.risk: Tyre sizes/rim fit are unknown (assorted sizes), so buyer may not be able to use them for a specific vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo showing each tyre’s full sidewall markings clearly (e.g., width/aspect/rim like 205/55R16) plus a count of how many of each size.
risks.if_unproven: Price as assorted used tyres with unknown fit (worst-case: mismatched sizes for the buyer’s vehicle).

risks.risk: Tread depth may be far less than claimed; photos cannot confirm 90% without measurement.
risks.proof: A close-up of tread depth gauge readings (mm) on multiple tyres, or a clear video showing the gauge on at least 3–5 tyres.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used tyres with uncertain tread condition (worst-case: near-worn tread).

risks.risk: Hidden damage such as punctures, sidewall cuts, repairs, or bulges may exist even if not obvious in stacked photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each tyre’s sidewall and tread for punctures/cuts/repairs, including any repaired areas and the full circumference (or a slow 360° video per tyre).
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres with potential defects (worst-case: may be repairable/unsafe for road use).

risks.risk: Matching set status is unknown; tyres may be different brands/models/patterns, affecting handling and safety.
risks.proof: Photos showing brand/model and pattern on all tyres (or at least the full set intended for one vehicle), with side-by-side comparison.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-matching assorted used tyres (worst-case: mixed brands/sizes/patterns).

risks.risk: DOT/manufacturing year and age are unknown; older tyres can be riskier even if tread looks okay.
risks.proof: Clear close-ups of the DOT code on multiple tyres (showing week/year), plus a quick count of how many are similar age.
risks.if_unproven: Price as older used tyres with unknown age (worst-case: older DOT dates).

risks.risk: Tubeless vs tube-type is unknown; wrong type can cause installation/fitment issues.
risks.proof: A close-up of the valve area and sidewall text indicating tubeless/tube-type, or a photo of the inside bead area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown type (worst-case: buyer may need extra checks/parts).

proof_requests: Provide clear sidewall close-ups for each tyre showing the full size (e.g., 205/55R16) and brand/model/pattern text.
Provide a count of tyres by each size (how many of each size).
Provide tread depth measurements in mm using a gauge on multiple tyres (at least 3–5) with photos/video.
Provide close-ups (and ideally 360° video) of sidewalls and tread to confirm no punctures, cuts, repairs/patches, or bulges.
Provide clear DOT code close-ups (week/year) for multiple tyres.
Confirm whether tyres are tubeless or tube-type with a close-up of valve/sidewall markings.
response.reason: The witness report identifies the item type as used car tyres (assorted sizes). However, key condition details (tread depth in mm, damage/repairs, DOT age, matching set) are not verifiable from the provided images, so it should be priced at the worst-case used-tyre scenario until the requested proof is provided.
